selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在目标位置形成平心之环，持续5秒。进入环中的敌人将被推出环外。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你受到的物理伤害降低10%，且每4秒额外降低10%，直到受到一次物理攻击，最多可叠加至4层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack, stacking up to 4.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 现在轮回之触可以对剩余生命值低于15%的目标使用，造成相当于你最大生命值35%的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 分筋错骨现在会移除目标的所有激怒效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Paralysis now removes all Enrage effects from its target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使目标瘫痪，持续1分钟。只能对一个目标使用。伤害可能取消该效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受到的所有治疗效果提高6%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases all healing taken by 6%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使一名友方目标的移动速度提高70%，持续6秒，并解除所有定身和诱捕效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 移除目标身上所有的中毒和疾病效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Removes all Poison and Disease effects from the target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
踏风
受到的所有伤害降低10%。

 酒仙,  织雾
受到的所有伤害降低3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Windwalker
Reduces all damage taken by 10%.

 Brewmaster,  Mistweaver
Reduces all damage taken by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自动攻击爆击几率提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your auto attack critical strike chance is increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 未进入战斗时，你的移动速度提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激活乾元之巅会使你释放一次强力践踏，对附近敌人造成([700% of Attack Power])点自然伤害，超过5个目标时伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Activating Zenith causes you to release a powerful stomp, dealing (700% of Attack Power) Nature damage to nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
踏风
激战时真气的流动令你变得坚毅，在战斗中每3秒获得一层魔法吸收护盾，吸收相当于最大生命值0.6%的伤害，最多叠加至6%。

 酒仙,  织雾
激战时真气的流动令你变得坚毅，在战斗中每3秒获得一层魔法吸收护盾，吸收相当于最大生命值1.0%的伤害，最多叠加至10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Windwalker
Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 0.6% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 6%.

 Brewmaster,  Mistweaver
Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 1.0% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 造成的所有伤害提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases all damage dealt by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将你的肉体和灵魂分离，并将灵魂留在原地，持续15分钟。使用魂体双分：转移，让你的肉体和你的灵魂交换位置。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 滚地翻令你身轻如羽，使你可以在5秒内施展一次二段跳，向前冲刺一小段距离，滚地翻的冷却时间提高2秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 造成的魔法伤害提高5%，造成的治疗效果提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Magical damage done increased by 5% and healing done increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你会根据当前生命值获得一个额外效果。

生命值高于90%：移动速度提高5%。该效果可与其他相似效果叠加。

生命值在90%与35%之间：受到的伤害降低5%。

生命值低于35%：受到的治疗效果提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
酒仙
让你的皮肤化为坚石，持续15秒[，并使醉拳的化解量提高20%]。

 踏风,  织雾
让你的皮肤化为坚石，持续15秒[，并使醉拳的化解量提高20%]。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:

Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec[, and Staggering 20% of incoming damage].

 Windwalker (Windwalker Monk)

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 壮胆酒的冷却时间缩短30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 轮回之触的冷却时间缩短90秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
酒仙,  织雾
你造成的物理伤害提高5%，闪避提高2%。

 踏风

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Brewmaster,  Mistweaver
Increases your Physical damage done by 5% and Avoidance increased by 2%.

 Windwalker
Increases your Physical damage done by 5% and Avoidance increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使扫堂腿的范围提高4码。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使滚地翻的冷却时间缩短5秒，使用次数上限提高1次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使分筋错骨的冷却时间缩短15秒，扫堂腿的冷却时间缩短10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Paralysis by 15 sec and the cooldown of Leg Sweep by 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高70%，神鹤引项踢的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rising Sun Kick deals 70% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
踏风
向上猛踢，造成[([143.8% of Attack Power]) * [(攻击强度 * 0.98)][((攻击强度 + [Offhand Attack Power]) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 攻击强度]点物理伤害。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Windwalker
Kick upwards, dealing [(143.8% of Attack Power) * [(Attack Power * 0.98)][((Attack Power + Offhand Attack Power) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / Attack Power] Physical damage.

 Brewmaster
Kick upwards, dealing (143.8% of Attack Power) Physical damage.

 Mistweaver
Kick upwards, dealing (143.8% of Attack Power) Physical damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激活壮胆酒会尽可能将你身上当前激活的所有有害魔法效果返还给施法者。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Activating Fortifying Brew transfers all currently active harmful magical effects on you back to their original caster if possible.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 移花接木的治疗效果会根据你损失的生命值提高，最多提高100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Expel Harm's healing is increased by up to 100%, based on your missing health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
织雾
施放旭日东升踢后，你的下一次活血术变为瞬发。

 踏风
施放旭日东升踢后，你的下一次活血术变为瞬发。

此效果还会使活血术的能量消耗降低75%。

 酒仙
施放醉酿投后，你的下一次活血术变为瞬发。

此效果还会使活血术的能量消耗降低75%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Brewmaster
After casting Keg Smash, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

This effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.

 Mistweaver
After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

 Windwalker
After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

This effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 扫堂腿结束时，会施加5.0秒的金刚震效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Leg Sweep applies Disable for 5.0 sec when it ends.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 猛击目标的咽喉，打断其施法，并阻止其施放任何同系的法术，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Jabs the target in the throat, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 爆击几率提高2%。白虎雪怒激活时，该效果提高100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical Strike chance increased by 2%. This effect is increased by 100% while Xuen, the White Tiger is active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 幻灭踢会使旭日东升踢和怒雷破的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury by 1.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 最大真气值提高1点，最大能量值提高20点，能量回复速度提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your maximum Chi by 1, maximum Energy by 20, and your Energy regeneration by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 旭日东升踢有等同于急速的100%的几率被再次触发，造成([50% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，并恢复1点真气。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rising Sun Kick has a chance equal to 100% of your haste to trigger a second time, dealing (50% of Attack Power) Physical damage and restoring 1 Chi.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
怒雷破的伤害提高，比例相当于你的急速的100%。怒雷破每次造成伤害，都会使其造成的伤害提高10%，并在怒雷破结束时重置。

怒雷破结束后，你的自动攻击速度提高60%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Fists of Fury's damage is increased by 100% of your haste and Fists of Fury does 10% more damage each time it deals damage, resetting when Fists of Fury ends.

Your auto attack speed is increased by 60% for 8 sec after Fists of Fury ends.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 神鹤引项踢会引爆能量并产生真气破，对8码内的所有敌人造成([351% of Attack Power])点自然伤害，目标超过5个时伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Spinning Crane Kick detonates into a Chi Explosion, dealing (351% of Attack Power) Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards, reduced beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 乾元之巅的冷却时间缩短20秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The cooldown of Zenith is reduced by 20 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
真气消耗降低1点，并且幻灭踢使受影响技能的冷却时间额外缩短1秒，持续15秒。

激活乾元之巅会重置旭日东升踢的剩余冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Chi costs are reduced by 1 and Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of affected abilities by an additional 1 sec for 15 sec.

Activating Zenith resets the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
猛虎掌会使下个幻灭踢额外攻击一次，造成([84.7% of Attack Power])点物理伤害，最多可叠加4次。

幻灭踢有12%的几率重置旭日东升踢的剩余冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Tiger Palm causes your next Blackout Kick to strike an additional time dealing (84.7% of Attack Power) Physical damage, stacking up to 4.

Blackout Kick has a 12% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自动攻击有30%的几率改为脚踢目标，造成([484.38% of Attack Power])点物理伤害。使用双手武器时造成的伤害提高。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your auto attacks have a 30% chance to instead kick your target dealing (484.38% of Attack Power) Physical damage. Damage increased while using a two-handed weapon.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你消耗“幻灭踢！”效果时，有100%的几率产生1点真气。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you consume Blackout Kick!, you have a 100% chance to generate 1 Chi.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗赤精之舞后，你有100%的几率获得幻灭踢！
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You have a 100% chance to gain Blackout Kick! after consuming Dance of Chi-Ji.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗真气有几率使你的下一个神鹤引项踢不消耗真气。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Spending Chi has a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick cost no Chi.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 风领主之击和升龙霸有100%的几率激活赤精之舞。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have a 100% chance to activate Dance of Chi-Ji.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 旭日东升踢的伤害提高15%，爆击伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15% and critical strike damage increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你在乾元之巅期间的伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your damage during Zenith is increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的近战攻击速度提高30%。在乾元之巅期间该加成提高至60%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your melee attack speed is increased by 30%. This bonus is increased to 60% during Zenith.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 猛虎掌激活幻灭踢！的几率提高75%，猛虎掌的伤害提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Tiger Palm's chance to activate Blackout Kick! is increased by 75% and Tiger Palm's damage is increased by 30%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
旭日东升踢爆击时，怒雷破的冷却时间缩短4秒。

神鹤引项踢每击中一个不同的目标，怒雷破的冷却时间缩短0.5秒，最多缩短2.5秒。

旭日东升踢的爆击几率提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Rising Sun Kick critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 4 sec.

Spinning Crane Kick reduces the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 0.5 sec for each unique target struck, up to 2.5 sec.

The critical strike chance of Rising Sun Kick is increased by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 神鹤引项踢的伤害提高15%，范围扩大15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Spinning Crane Kick damage increased by 15% and its radius is increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 旭日东升踢从精通：组合拳获得的效果提高40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rising Sun Kick gains 40% additional effectiveness from Mastery: Combo Strikes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 能量上限提高30点，猛虎掌消耗的能量降低5点。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases maximum Energy by 30. Tiger Palm's Energy cost reduced by 5.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你使用猛虎掌时，有8%的几率使你在15秒内施放的下一次幻灭踢不会消耗真气。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You have a 8% chance when you Tiger Palm to cause your next Blackout Kick to cost no Chi within 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每次触发组合拳的连续攻击都会使伤害提高1%，最多叠加5次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each successive attack that triggers Combo Strikes in a row grants 1% increased damage, stacking up to 5 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
未进入战斗时，你的真气会平衡至2点，而非完全耗尽。

你的耐力提高5%，并且每15秒，你的下一个猛虎掌还会施放移花接木。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
While out of combat, your Chi balances to 2 instead of depleting to empty.

Your stamina is increased by 5% and every 15 sec, your next Tiger Palm also casts Expel Harm.

subSpellsCn.name: 移花接木
subSpellsCn.description: 逼出体内逆行的真气，恢复([120% of Spell Power])点生命值，并对20码范围内的一名敌人造成相当于治疗量10%的自然伤害。 [移花接木: 吸取疗伤珠中的真气，提高移花接木的治疗效果。] [反向伤害: 产生[([120% of Spell Power]) + 30]点真气。]

subSpellsEn.name: Expel Harm
subSpellsEn.description: Expel negative chi from your body, healing for (120% of Spell Power) and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards. [Expel Harm: Draws in the positive chi of all your Healing Spheres to increase the healing of Expel Harm] [Reverse Harm: Generates [(120% of Spell Power) + 30] Chi.]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 对你前方的所有目标施展拳击，在4秒内对你的主要目标造成[5 * ([260.82% of Attack Power])]点物理伤害，对其他所有敌人造成[5 * ([260.82% of Attack Power]) * 60 / 100]点伤害。目标数量超过5个后，造成的伤害降低。可以在移动中引导。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Pummels all targets in front of you, dealing [5 * (260.82% of Attack Power)] Physical damage to your primary target and [5 * (260.82% of Attack Power) * 60 / 100] damage to all other enemies over 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Can be channeled while moving.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 践行隐秘宗门的严酷体术，在连续打击中积攒疾风之力，并在积累完毕时释放十连疾风打击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Executes rigorous discipline from the hidden monastery, charging flurry strikes through consecutive martial combos.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 幻灭踢造成的爆击伤害提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blackout Kick deals an additional 30% critical damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
当你的生命值降至50%时，召唤钢铁漩涡，使你的招架几率和闪避提高15%，持续6秒。

该效果每180秒只能触发一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:

This effect can not occur more than once every 180 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的攻击穿透12%的护甲。

 酒仙
你的自动攻击有几率产生1-2层疾风拳势。施放醉酿投会释放所有疾风拳势，每层造成([60% of Attack Power])点物理伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Windwalker
Your auto attacks have a chance to generate 1-2 Flurry Charges. When you cast Fists of Fury, unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing (60% of Attack Power) Physical damage per charge. 

 Brewmaster
Your auto attacks have a chance to generate 1-2 Flurry Charges. When you cast Keg Smash, unleash all Flurry Charges, dealing (60% of Attack Power) Physical damage per charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 急速提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Haste increased by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
酒仙
自动攻击的爆击会使疾风拳势层数翻倍。


醉酿投的伤害提高35%。

 踏风
自动攻击的爆击会使疾风拳势层数翻倍。

怒雷破的伤害提高50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Brewmaster
Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.


Keg Smash damage increased by 35%.

 Windwalker
Auto attack critical strikes generate double the amount of Flurry Charges.

Fists of Fury damage increased by 50%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
酒仙
消耗能量的技能造成的伤害提高20%。
玄牛下凡的冷却时间缩短25秒。

 踏风
消耗能量的技能造成的伤害提高40%。
乾元之巅的冷却时间缩短10秒。

Brewmaster
Energy spenders deal an additional 20% damage.
The cooldown of Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox is reduced by 25 sec.

 Windwalker
Energy spenders deal an additional 40% damage.
The cooldown of Zenith is reduced by 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
踏风
乾元之巅会使旭日东升踢和神鹤引项踢施放3次疾风乱打。

 酒仙
玄牛下凡会使火焰吐息施放3次疾风乱打。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Brewmaster
Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox causes Breath of Fire to launch 3 Flurry Strikes.

 Windwalker
Zenith causes Rising Sun Kick and Spinning Crane Kick to launch 3 Flurry Strikes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的敏捷提高4%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your agility is increased by 4%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 滚地翻的冷却时间减少10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The cooldown of Roll is decreased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
施展拳法，发动盘旋向上的毁灭性攻击，对附近的所有敌人造成[3 * ([313.95% of Attack Power])]点伤害，并对第一个击中的目标额外造成([450% of Attack Power])点伤害。目标超过5个时造成的伤害降低。

只有在怒雷破和旭日东升踢都在冷却时才能使用。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Performs a devastating whirling upward strike, dealing [3 * (313.95% of Attack Power)] damage to all nearby enemies and an additional (450% of Attack Power) damage to the first target struck. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Only usable while both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are on cooldown.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 怒雷破的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: The damage of Fists of Fury is increased by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在消耗幻灭踢！后，旭日东升踢有60%的几率变为疾风呼啸踢。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: After consuming Blackout Kick!, Rising Sun Kick has a 60% chance to become Rushing Wind Kick.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 疾风乱打对6码内的所有敌人造成([52% of Attack Power])点自然伤害，超过8个目标后伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Flurry Strikes deal (52% of Attack Power) Nature damage to all enemies within 6 yds, reduced beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
踏风
激活乾元之巅会立即获得10层疾风乱打，在你的下一次攻击时触发，效果为70%。

 酒仙
激活玄牛下凡会立即获得10层疾风乱打，在你的下一次攻击时触发，效果为70%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Brewmaster
Activating Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox instantly grants 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes that trigger on your next attack at 70% effectiveness.

 Windwalker
Activating Zenith instantly grants 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes that trigger on your next attack at 70% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
踏风
乾元镇踏的伤害提高20%。

 酒仙
玄牛下凡的践踏伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Brewmaster
Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox's stomp damage increased by 20%.

 Windwalker
Zenith Stomp damage increased by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
每消耗3点真气都会产生虎眼酒效果。乾元之巅会消耗最多20层虎眼酒，每消耗一层使你在其持续期间的爆击几率提高1%。

在战斗外会快速生成最多10层，最多可产生30层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Every 3 Chi spent generates Tigereye Brew. Zenith consumes up to 20 Tigereye Brew stacks to increase your critical strike chance for its duration by 1% per stack.

Generates quickly up to 10 stacks while out of combat and may generate up to a maximum of 30 stacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的法术和技能造成的爆击伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your spells and abilities deal 5% increased critical strike damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 乾元之巅现在使你能额外使用2次乾元镇踏。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Zenith now grants access to 2 additional Zenith Stomps.
